FILED BY WAVE 47 DECIDE, NOT BUILT — because the surface has no runnable local gate and this wave will not hand a builder a gate nobody could run.

THE DEFECT, READ ON origin/main 49345a98c. web/app/api/find-event/route.ts is the ONLY live caller of the search interaction endpoint. At :63-79 it calls await fetch(...) WITHOUT BINDING THE RESPONSE, then at :79 unconditionally return NextResponse.json({ ok: true }). The bare catch above it carries a declared best-effort comment ("a recording failure must not break search UX") — but that declaration covers EXCEPTIONS, not NON-2xx RESPONSES. So the 422 and 500 that search_controller.ex:339-348 now honestly emits become {ok:true} again one hop out, with no recorded: key at all.
PDS-D496 recorded this exact fact FROM THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION — as proof the union widening was "free" (no consumer breakage) — never as a residual defect. This row files the other reading.
TWO LEGAL ENDINGS, per the epic's second law: either the proxy's receipt DESCENDS from the upstream status (forward recorded:false and the reason), or the fire-and-forget is DECLARED IN CODE for non-2xx as well as for exceptions AND the receipt stops asserting that a write happened.

WHY IT IS NOT THIS WAVE, AND THIS IS THE FIRST OBLIGATION OF THE ROW. Both of web/'s local gates are RED ON UNTOUCHED main in the dev environment, measured by wave 47's decider:
  $ cd web && npm run typecheck   ->  TS2580 'Cannot find name process' (lib/use-live-search.ts:43,44), TS2307 'Cannot find module next' / 'node:fs' / 'node:url' / 'node:path' (next.config.ts:1-4)
  $ cd web && npm test            ->  failures on untouched files including tests/sheet-grid-render.test.ts and tests/valueref.test.ts
A surface whose gate cannot go green on main is a gate whose green costs nothing, because it never runs. Establish a runnable gate FIRST; then the fix is five lines.
ADJACENT AND ALSO UNGATED: the interaction routes appear in NO published contract — docs/openapi.json has 151 paths and none contains 'interaction' — and the JS SDK has no interaction verb at all (zero recordInteraction/interactionEventId in js/packages/core/src). The recorded: receipt's audience is currently empty.

WAVE 48 ROUND 1 — the epic's FIRST product-surface repair under the wish's own first noun. This row FOLDS pds-bl-w36-find-event-fourth-lie (same file, same defect, filed twelve waves earlier) — see criterion 6, which carries forward the one axis on which the w36 row was better.

*** CRITERION 1 OF THE OLD ROW IS DEAD. DO NOT QUOTE IT. *** It pinned "the current state (both typecheck and test red on main)" as the baseline. That baseline DOES NOT REPRODUCE. Four independent measurements, including a genuine clean-room `git worktree add --detach` at origin/main, give typecheck rc=0 with ZERO diagnostics, tests 288/288/0, lint rc=0; and CI run 30628247583 concluded SUCCESS on `web/ typecheck + unit tests + lint` while `git log 577f50be..origin/main -- web/` is EMPTY, so that green describes today's main. PDS-D688 deferred this repair on a HOST FACT wearing a repo's clothes.

THE FOUR-STEP INSTALL PREAMBLE IS MANDATORY (PDS-D693). A fresh worktree has NO web/node_modules at all, and THREE different partial installs have now been mistaken for repo defects. Run exactly:
  pnpm --dir js install --frozen-lockfile
  pnpm --dir js --filter @barkpark/core build
  pnpm --dir js --filter @barkpark/react build
  pnpm --dir web install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
`--ignore-scripts` IS REQUIRED ON DARWIN: without it sharp@0.34.5's postinstall tries a source build, ELIFECYCLE aborts BEFORE bin-linking, `node_modules/.bin` is absent, and all three gates fail with `sh: tsc: command not found` — a red that is not one. CI is ubuntu-x64 and gets a prebuild, so quote CI's own run as the L1 authority, never yours. The SECOND web install is also required: @barkpark/react is materialised as a store COPY, not a symlink, so building it after installing web/ leaves `dist` absent and reds TS2307 on four files.

THE DEFECT IS WORSE THAN FILED, IN THREE WAYS.
(1) LINE NUMBERS: the receipts are at :44 (unparsed body) and :78 (unconditional tail) on origin/main. Earlier briefs said :43/:79 — off by one. Anchor on 44/78.
(2) THE HONEST 422 CANNOT EVEN REACH THE CATCH. `await fetch(...)` at :54 and :65 are bare expression statements that DISCARD the Response, and **fetch does not reject on 4xx/5xx**. So wave 47's honest 422/500 never reaches the `catch (err)` at :73 — not surfaced, not bound, not even console.error'd. The docstring at :36-37 ("Upstream errors are logged server-side, not surfaced") is FALSE for HTTP-status errors; only network failures are logged.
(3) SIX EXITS, THREE LIE CLASSES, AND THE THIRD IS FILED NOWHERE. Both existing rows describe two lying exits. There are six: upstream 2xx; upstream non-2xx (422/500); fetch throws; unparsable body; and **the body parsed but NO WRITE WAS EVER ATTEMPTED** — kind:"sideways", or kind:"correction" with no `to`, or kind:"click" with no `queryEventId`. Today those return the identical {ok:true} as a recorded signal. A criterion written from either old row's text drops that class silently.

THE SHAPE IS DECIDED (PDS-D695): UNIFORM 200 WITH A DESCENDING `recorded` FIELD, all six exits. Do not re-litigate it. 400-for-unparsable would ALSO descend from a measurement, so honesty does not decide the status — what decides it is that if the status line carries the receipt for ONE exit and not the other five, a caller checking `res.ok` sees RED for a malformed body and GREEN for an upstream 500, the exact inversion this epic exists to kill. And it PORTS AN IN-REPO PATTERN rather than arguing a manifesto: `web/app/api/find/route.ts:56-59` already returns 200 with a `message` derived from the caught error, eleven lines from a launder of the same law at :27-29.

DO NOT "FIX" finder.tsx (PDS-D696). `web/components/finder.tsx:49` is `void fetch(...).catch(() => {})` with keepalive:true. The browser is NOT the consumer and should not be — it cannot act on a dropped analytics signal and a console.debug would be decoration. The field is ENFORCED by the test plus CI, not consumed. Say enforced in your evidence; claiming a consumer that does not exist is this epic's disease one level out.

THE HARNESS MUST BE INVENTED — real cost, budget for it. ZERO of the 39 files in web/__tests__/ tests any of the five routes, so there is no route-handler pattern to copy. Import the POST export directly and stub fetch. Two bundler-only resolutions must be replayed in `web/__tests__/support/server-only-loader.mjs`: the `@/` tsconfig paths alias (node does not read tsconfig, and the alias is extensionless so it also needs `.ts` appended), and `next/server` -> `next/server.js` (next's package.json has NO `exports` map at all, so bare ESM resolution of an extensionless subpath fails outright).

*** COLLISION FENCE: `web/__tests__/support/server-only-loader.mjs` IS SHARED BY ALL 39 EXISTING WEB TESTS. *** Your change must be purely additive and the FULL suite must stay green through it.

GATE (run all four, quote all four, after the preamble above):
  pnpm --dir web run typecheck ; echo TC=$?
  pnpm --dir web run test ; echo TEST=$?
  pnpm --dir web run lint ; echo LINT=$?
  node --test --test-reporter=spec --import ./__tests__/support/stub-server-only.mjs __tests__/find-event-receipt.test.ts   # from web/

FILES: web/app/api/find-event/route.ts, web/__tests__/find-event-receipt.test.ts (new), web/__tests__/support/server-only-loader.mjs.
